why: The leaf sequence is what a depth-first traversal emits when it records only nodes with no children, left before right. Compute it for both trees and compare.
hints: Any DFS that goes left before right visits the leaves in left-to-right order.
Write a helper that pushes a node's value to a list when it has no left and no right child, and otherwise recurses into its children.
Compare the two lists. O(n1 + n2) time; use an explicit stack (push right, then left) to avoid deep recursion on a 10000-node chain.
pitfalls: Only true leaves count; a node with one child is not a leaf.
Sequences must match in order and length, not just as sets.
